# Levins metapopulation {#sec-levins}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    \frac{dp}{dt} = c p (1 - p) - e p
$${#eq-levins-metapop}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Levins metapopulation model trajectories for four scenarios"
#| label: fig-levins-sim

library(deSolve)

# Function to define Levins metapopulation ODE
levins_ode <- function(t, state, parms) {
  p <- state["p"]
  c <- parms["c"]
  e <- parms["e"]

  dp_dt <- c * p * (1 - p) - e * p

  list(dp_dt)
}

# Parameters
times <- seq(0, 100, by = 0.1)

# Scenario 1: Default (p0 = 0.1, c = 0.5, e = 0.1)
c_default <- 0.5
e_default <- 0.1
p_eq_default <- 1 - e_default / c_default  # Equilibrium
parms_default <- c(c = c_default, e = e_default)
state_default <- c(p = 0.1)
traj_default <- ode(state_default, times, levins_ode, parms_default)

# Scenario 2: Starting at p = 1 (same c and e as default)
state_p1 <- c(p = 1.0)
traj_p1 <- ode(state_p1, times, levins_ode, parms_default)

# Scenario 3: Same equilibrium but higher c and e (same ratio)
# If e/c ratio stays same, equilibrium stays same
# Using c = 1.0, e = 0.2 (same ratio as default: 0.1/0.5 = 0.2/1.0)
c_higher <- 1.0
e_higher <- 0.2
p_eq_higher <- 1 - e_higher / c_higher  # Same as default
parms_higher <- c(c = c_higher, e = e_higher)
traj_higher <- ode(state_default, times, levins_ode, parms_higher)

# Scenario 4: Lower c (smaller equilibrium)
c_lower <- 0.3
e_lower <- 0.1
p_eq_lower <- 1 - e_lower / c_lower  # Smaller equilibrium
parms_lower <- c(c = c_lower, e = e_lower)
traj_lower <- ode(state_default, times, levins_ode, parms_lower)

# Create plot
plot(times, traj_default[, "p"], type = "l", col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.7),
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Proportion occupied (p)",
     main = "Levins metapopulation model: four scenarios",
     ylim = c(0, 1), lwd = 2)

# Add other trajectories
lines(times, traj_p1[, "p"], col = rgb(0, 0.7, 0, 0.7), lwd = 2)
lines(times, traj_higher[, "p"], col = rgb(1, 0.5, 0, 0.7), lwd = 2)
lines(times, traj_lower[, "p"], col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.7), lwd = 2)

# Add equilibrium lines
abline(h = p_eq_default, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3), lty = 2, lwd = 1)
abline(h = p_eq_lower, col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.3), lty = 2, lwd = 1)

# Add legend
legend("right",
       legend = c(paste0("Default: p₀=0.1, c=", c_default, ", e=", e_default),
                  paste0("p₀=1.0, c=", c_default, ", e=", e_default),
                  paste0("p₀=0.1, c=", c_higher, ", e=", e_higher, " (higher, same eq.)"),
                  paste0("p₀=0.1, c=", c_lower, ", e=", e_lower, " (lower c)")),
       col = c(rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.8), rgb(0, 0.7, 0, 0.8),
               rgb(1, 0.5, 0, 0.8), rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.8)),
       lwd = 2, cex = 0.85)
```
